explication: Magpie is a local model gateway and cross-agent configuration app. The main workflow is: configure a provider, choose a model for an installed agent, then let that agent send requests through the local gateway, which translates and routes them to provider accounts. Routing groups provide failover; the product also includes agent configuration, usage/session views, plugins, and image, vision, and search tools. The graph combines README-documented behavior with relationships visible in the sampled source index; unsampled subsystem links are omitted where their callers are not shown.
